issue.title: test_reverse_range_cycles_backward_wraps_and_reenters_from_custom fails once under a loaded full lane, passes on rerun
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-17x.13.10.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2, 2026-09-25 ~18:59Z) and routed by the sase-17x.13.10 land agent. The Statistics-pane filter test failed once in that phase's full scoped-escalated lane at host load ~20 and passed on rerun on the same tree; the phase touched only Command Line completion code. Likely load-sensitive timing; root cause not investigated. It passed in the land agent's own full lane (47647 passed) later the same day.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 fail then 1 pass on an unchanged tree (phase sase-17x.13.10.4), then passed again in a later full lane; failed only under parallel load, no serial failure observed.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (escalated full lane at host load ~20)

The epic repair commit touches neither Statistics code nor this test; this matches the existing exact-node load-sensitive flake.
